# Generate a commit message for the current changes in the project

Create a concise commit message based on the current changes in the project.
Use all the common rules, practices and approaches to generate message text.
Be concise, keep the message under 20 words, and use the imperative mood. Include a brief description of the changes made, the reason for the changes, and any relevant context or references. Avoid using vague terms and focus on the specific impact of the changes.
